name: sharpps-mcp
description: Connect any AI agent to SharpPS over MCP: Replayr (write Playwright test scripts, run them on the Replayr runner, read Jam-like reports) and Identity Groups (list groups and members, add or remove members, with scoped OAuth).

interface.shortDescription: Run Playwright tests on Replayr and manage Identity Groups over MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect any AI agent to SharpPS over MCP: Replayr (write Playwright test scripts, run them on the Replayr runner, read Jam-like reports) and Identity Groups (list groups and members, add or remove members, with scoped OAuth). Sign in with OAuth when the agent asks (Replayr also accepts an API token).
